verdict.rationale: The Terminal API and Management API use JSON/HTTP calls that can be automated and tested via a simulated testing system (docs-1, docs-11, docs-12, docs-28), suggesting some headless/CI-friendly automation of terminal management and payment flows. However, actual in-person payment capture inherently requires a physical terminal or device interaction, so it cannot be fully run headlessly end-to-end, and no CI-specific tooling or SDKs are mentioned.
